requirements.text: The system shall allow Detention Facility Officers to capture defendant, incident, and financial information within 48 hours of arrest.
The system shall allow magistrates to electronically review and submit requests for counsel within 24 hours of the indigency hearing.
The system shall allow the Office of Attorney Appointments to process requests for counsel no later than the end of the first working day after receipt.
The system shall notify law enforcement agencies of a denied request for counsel within 24 hours of the denial.
The system shall notify the appointed attorney and defendant of an appointment within 24 hours of the appointment.
The system shall allow appointed attorneys to record the date and type of first contact with the defendant within one working day of the appointment.
The system shall notify the Office of Attorney Appointments if an appointed attorney fails to make contact with the defendant within one working day of the appointment.
The system shall integrate with the Court Case Management System for case information and attorney appointment tracking.
The system shall integrate with the District Attorney Electronic Case Filing System (ECFS) for case filing notifications.
The system shall integrate with external County accounting systems for processing attorney compensation.
The system shall provide reporting capabilities for compliance with the Texas Fair Defense Act, including metrics on appointment times, contact times, and billing.
The system shall comply with the Texas Uniform Electronic Transactions Act (UETA) and Texas Department of Information Resources guidelines for electronic transactions and signed records.
The system shall support the generation of various reports including daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, and ad-hoc timeframes.
The system shall adhere to the Global Justice XML Data Model (GJXDM) as defined by the US Department of Justice Office of Justice Programs.
The system shall support the legal requirements mandated by the Texas Code of Criminal Procedure (CCP) Articles 1.051, 15.17, 26.04, 26.05, and 26.052.
